beats.label: S1 · Coming home
beats.text: Clark loses his job and mother on the same day; when the twins survive a fatal barn fall, the family moves back to Smallville so any powered son has space to grow.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the show's whole premise — the Kents as a family, not a franchise — and puts everyone on the map for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S1 · The powered twin
beats.text: Jordan turns out to be the powered twin; Clark reveals he is Superman to both boys and begins Jordan's training at the Fortress with Jor-El's hologram.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Jordan-has-powers, Jonathan-does-not split defines the family dynamic and Jonathan's later resentment arcs.

beats.label: S1 · The DOD arsenal
beats.text: A masked 'Captain Luthor' hunts Superman with Kryptonite, forcing Sam to reveal to his son-in-law that he has been stockpiling a whole anti-Superman arsenal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Project 7734, the Kryptonite weapons cache that returns in later seasons as a permanent leash on Superman.

beats.label: S1 · Irons unmasked
beats.text: Captain Luthor is unmasked as John Henry Irons from a parallel Earth whose Superman went evil and killed his Lois, his wife.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Irons, who becomes a permanent co-protagonist, and plants his complicated relationship with a Lois who is not his.

beats.label: S1 · Edge is Tal-Rho
beats.text: Morgan Edge is revealed as Tal-Rho, Clark's Kryptonian half-brother, mining Smallville's X-Kryptonite to implant Kryptonian minds into locals, Kyle included.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season antagonist reveal, and the event that shatters the Cushings — Kyle's near-loss anchors the marriage strain that runs into next season.

beats.label: S1 · Tal-Rho caged
beats.text: Superman and John Henry Irons defeat Tal-Rho and reverse the possessions, restoring Kyle and the rest; Tal-Rho is imprisoned at the DOD.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the season plot, but leaves Tal-Rho alive and accessible — a chess piece the next season pulls off the board and uses.

beats.label: S1 · Natalie arrives
beats.text: Irons plans to leave, but a pod delivers his daughter Natalie from his dead Earth; she meets a Lois with her mother's face but not her mother.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Natalie becomes a Season 2+ core character; the whole Irons subplot pivots on this arrival.

cliffhanger.text: Tal-Rho is caged and the Subjekts reversed, but a Kryptonian death-arsenal now exists in DOD hands and Irons's daughter Natalie has just stepped out of an escape pod into a family she has never met.
questions: Can Natalie build a life with a father she thought she'd lost and a Lois who is not her mother?
What does Kyle and Lana's marriage look like now that she knows how close he came to being lost forever?
Now that Project 7734's Kryptonite weapons exist, who gets to decide when they are used?

characters.name: Clark Kent / Superman
characters.line: Now living openly in Smallville as an assistant coach; his sons, Lana, and Sam all know his secret.

characters.name: Lois Lane
characters.line: His wife; quit the Daily Planet and now writes for the Smallville Gazette.

characters.name: Jordan Kent
characters.line: The anxious younger twin who inherited Clark's powers and is learning to control them.

characters.name: Jonathan Kent
characters.line: The older twin, football player, no powers — quietly aware of the imbalance.

characters.name: Lana Lang Cushing
characters.line: Clark's high school ex and the family's closest local friend; helped bring Edge down.

characters.name: Kyle Cushing
characters.line: Lana's husband and the town's fire chief; was briefly a Kryptonian Subjekt, restored but shaken.

characters.name: Sarah Cushing
characters.line: Their teenage daughter, tentatively together with Jordan.

characters.name: General Sam Lane
characters.line: Lois's father; head of the DOD, keeper of the Kryptonite arsenal built to kill Superman if he ever turns.

characters.name: John Henry Irons
characters.line: Widower engineer from a parallel Earth whose Superman went evil; chose to stay on this one.

characters.name: Natalie Irons
characters.line: His daughter, just arrived from that dead Earth in an escape pod.

characters.name: Tal-Rho / Morgan Edge
characters.line: Clark's Kryptonian half-brother; his plan to resurrect Krypton failed and he is held at the DOD.

beats.label: S2 · Visions and a rival
beats.text: Three months on, Superman starts having debilitating visions; a new DOD chief, Anderson, fields his own super-team because Clark refuses to put America first.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up both the mystery driving the season and the antagonist within the DOD who will eventually go rogue.

beats.label: S2 · Bizarro
beats.text: The visions come from Bizarro, a scarred Superman from an 'Inverse World' sent to kill cult leader Ally Allston before her plan destroys both worlds.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the season's real threat and the two-worlds mechanic that drives everything to follow.

beats.label: S2 · X-K and Lucy
beats.text: Lois's estranged sister Lucy resurfaces as Ally's devoted follower; Jonathan buys X-Kryptonite from his girlfriend Candice and secretly starts using it for powers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two threads that shape Jonathan's arc and Lois's family for the rest of the show; the X-K story rewires who he is going into next season.

beats.label: S2 · Kyle's affair
beats.text: Kyle's past affair with Tonya spills out at Sarah's quinceañera, blowing up his marriage with Lana just as her mayoral campaign accelerates.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single event that ends the Cushing marriage; the fallout is a load-bearing piece of every subsequent season.

beats.label: S2 · Worlds merging
beats.text: Ally opens a portal to the Inverse World and merges with her doppelgänger, gaining power to fuse both worlds; a corrupted Anderson dies helping her get there.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's crisis point and Anderson's exit; sets up the final act and clears a slot at the DOD.

beats.label: S2 · Lana knows
beats.text: Lana wins the election, and Clark trusts her enough to reveal that he is Superman; Jordan flies for the first time intercepting the inverse Jonathan mid-attack.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two permanent power-ups — Lana as mayor and Superman-aware ally, Jordan as flight-capable — that reshape the rest of the show.

beats.label: S2 · Mannheim named
beats.text: Tal-Rho helps Superman split the merged Allys and separate the worlds; a visitor warns Irons that Bruno Mannheim killed this Earth's version of him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The seed line that launches the entire next season — the first mention of Bruno Mannheim.

cliffhanger.text: Ally is caged and the worlds separated, but a visitor has just told John Henry Irons that this Earth's version of him was murdered by a Metropolis crime boss named Bruno Mannheim.
questions: Who is Bruno Mannheim and what did he want with the other John Henry Irons?
Can Jonathan stay clean now that he has tasted having powers?
Where do Kyle and Lana land, together or apart, after her election and their split?

characters.name: Clark Kent / Superman
characters.line: Restored to his role after Bizarro; has now revealed his identity to Lana at Lois's urging.

characters.name: Lois Lane
characters.line: Half-owner of the Gazette; reconciled with sister Lucy and has told Chrissy that Clark is Superman.

characters.name: Jordan Kent
characters.line: The powered twin; has just flown for the first time and is training privately with Sam.

characters.name: Jonathan Kent
characters.line: No powers of his own; took X-Kryptonite for a stretch, now clean but grounded and on probation.

characters.name: Lana Lang
characters.line: Newly elected mayor of Smallville; separated from Kyle, and knows Clark's secret.

characters.name: Kyle Cushing
characters.line: Fire chief; moved out of the family home after his affair with Tonya was exposed.

characters.name: Sarah Cushing
characters.line: Back together with Jordan; navigating her parents' split and her own queerness.

characters.name: General Sam Lane
characters.line: Retired from the DOD after Anderson's tenure; still Lois's father and Jordan's mentor.

characters.name: John Henry Irons
characters.line: Hero of Smallville alongside Superman; just learned Bruno Mannheim killed this Earth's version of him.

characters.name: Natalie Irons
characters.line: Adjusted to this Earth; enrolled at Smallville High and close with the twins.

beats.label: S3 · Divorce, and a masked killer
beats.text: Lana and Kyle finalise their divorce, and a masked figure begins killing Bruno Mannheim's enemies; Clark confronts Bruno, who claims he helps the people Superman does not.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the season's two threads at once: the Cushing family's new shape and Mannheim as a rival civic saviour, not just a crime boss.

beats.label: S3 · Lois's cancer
beats.text: Lois is diagnosed with inflammatory breast cancer and begins chemo; the family and Smallville have to reckon with the fact that Superman cannot save her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's emotional spine; every subplot bends around it and it carries permanent weight into the next season.

beats.label: S3 · Peia and the blood
beats.text: The masked figure is Bruno's wife Peia, a powered killer now dying herself; Bruno uses the Inverse Superman's body to try to make a cure for her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts Bruno as a husband trying to save his wife, not a mustache-twirl villain — and sets up the Kryptonian-blood infrastructure Lex inherits.

beats.label: S3 · Natalie and Matteo
beats.text: Natalie starts dating a boy named Matteo, not knowing he is the Mannheims' son; John retaliates against Bruno's escalations, drawing the family into open war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The parallel-family collision that carries Natalie's arc for the season and shapes her heartbreak going into next.

beats.label: S3 · Lex out
beats.text: Bruno framed Lex Luthor years ago for the murder that let him take Metropolis; Peia dies before she can confess, and Lex walks out of prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single biggest S4 launcher — the show's largest villain is now free and holds a personal grudge against Lois specifically.

beats.label: S3 · Doomsday
beats.text: Lex targets the Bizarro corpse Bruno stole, killing and reviving it until it becomes a monster loyal to him — Doomsday.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the creature that opens the next season and kills Superman with it.

beats.label: S3 · On the moon
beats.text: Kyle proposes to Chrissy at the meteor shower; Lex unleashes Doomsday, and after a brutal fight Superman and the creature crash on the moon, charging each other.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger and also fixes the Kyle-Chrissy engagement that structures next season's B plot.

cliffhanger.text: Lex Luthor is out of prison and vowing revenge on the family who put him there; on the moon, Superman and a Doomsday built from Bizarro's corpse are hurtling at each other in a fight nobody has won yet.
questions: Can Superman beat a creature designed to come back stronger every time he kills it?
What does Lex do to the Kents once he stops circling and strikes?
Who else in Smallville is close to figuring out who Superman really is?

characters.name: Clark Kent / Superman
characters.line: Hurtling at Doomsday on the moon; his identity intact but his family openly targeted.

characters.name: Lois Lane
characters.line: Post-mastectomy and cancer-free; the group's discovery that Bruno framed Lex for Moxie's death is now the reason Lex is out.

characters.name: Jordan Kent
characters.line: Publicly cheered as Smallville's teen hero after saving the town from a tornado on camera.

characters.name: Jonathan Kent
characters.line: Working at the firehouse under Kyle; no powers, quietly overshadowed again.

characters.name: Lana Lang
characters.line: Mayor of Smallville; now dating John Henry Irons after her divorce from Kyle.

characters.name: Kyle Cushing
characters.line: Fire chief; engaged to Chrissy Beppo, who is pregnant with his child.

characters.name: Chrissy Beppo
characters.line: Lois's Gazette partner; pregnant and newly engaged to Kyle.

characters.name: Sam Lane
characters.line: Back at the DOD after retirement; Jordan's mentor and Lois's father.

characters.name: John Henry Irons
characters.line: Dating Lana; his war with Bruno is over now that Bruno is in prison.

characters.name: Natalie Irons
characters.line: Just broke up with Matteo after learning he is a Mannheim; adjusting to Sam's mentorship.

characters.name: Lex Luthor
characters.line: Just released from Stryker's; has weaponised the Bizarro corpse into Doomsday and is coming for Lois.

beats.label: S4 · Superman dies
beats.text: Doomsday kills Superman; Lex extracts his heart, and Jordan smuggles Clark's body to the Fortress in the hope of reviving him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The event the entire final season hangs from; the family is now the front line while Clark is out.

beats.label: S4 · Sam's heart
beats.text: Lex sends Doomsday after Sam Lane; Sam dies, but John transplants his heart into Clark and a resurrection serum brings Clark back with weakened powers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Sam permanently and reshapes Clark for the rest of the season — he is Superman again but fading.

beats.label: S4 · The phone call
beats.text: Lex plays Lois's old panicked phone call for Jordan, revealing she chose Jonathan over him; the twins fracture, then reconcile as Jonathan's own powers manifest.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single event that permanently rebalances the twins — Jonathan finally has powers and the Kents finally face what favouritism cost them.

beats.label: S4 · Elizabeth's refusal
beats.text: Lex's estranged pregnant daughter Elizabeth refuses to let him back into her life, hardening his resolve to destroy the Kents.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off the possibility that anyone can talk Lex down; from here he only accelerates.

beats.label: S4 · Coming out
beats.text: Under relentless Luthor pressure, Clark sits for a Daily Planet interview with Janet Olsen and publicly reveals that he is Superman.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's biggest permanent status change — the mask comes off — and closes the two-lives premise the whole series ran on.

beats.label: S4 · Doomsday down, Lex jailed
beats.text: Doomsday, reminded of his Inverse-world family, sacrifices himself to end the fight; Lex is exposed live on camera and jailed for life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the season and the series-long villain arc in one beat.

beats.label: S4 · After
beats.text: A year on, John marries Lana and Kyle marries Chrissy; Superman keeps saving the world with his sons for decades, then Lois dies, and years later Clark dies reunited with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The series' actual ending: a flash across the whole rest of the family's life so the reader knows how it all lands.

cliffhanger.text: The war with Luthor is over. Doomsday died sacrificing himself, Lex is buried in Stryker's for life, and Superman has told the world his name — then the show flashes across decades until Lois dies of returning cancer and, years later, Clark dies reunited with her.
questions: What kind of world does Superman leave behind when he finally puts down the cape?
Do the Kent twins carry his mantle after he is gone?
What becomes of the Irons family in the long years after their surrogate family is gone?

characters.name: Clark Kent / Superman
characters.line: Alive, revealed to the world, weakened but victorious; the immediate crisis is finally over.

characters.name: Lois Lane
characters.line: Cancer-free; her family is intact and Lex is behind her.

characters.name: Jordan Kent
characters.line: A public hero alongside his father; helped save Smallville from Doomsday.

characters.name: Jonathan Kent
characters.line: Now powered too, finally in step with his brother.

characters.name: Lana Lang
characters.line: About to marry John Henry Irons; still mayor of a town that knows everything.

characters.name: Kyle Cushing
characters.line: Rebuilding a life with Chrissy; a second child on the way.

characters.name: Chrissy Beppo
characters.line: Pregnant with her second child; about to marry Kyle.

characters.name: John Henry Irons
characters.line: Marrying Lana; still Steel.

characters.name: Natalie Irons
characters.line: A powered hero in her own right, and now part of a larger family.

characters.name: Lex Luthor
characters.line: Publicly exposed and locked in Stryker's Prison for life.
